RF-Scope APK build information
==============================

App name: RF-Scope
Package: com.rfscope.app
Version: 0.9.2 (versionCode 11)
Build type: debug (installable; Android Debug certificate)
Min SDK: 29 (Android 10)
Target/compile SDK: 34 (Android 14)
Built at: 2026-11-08 (Asia/Shanghai)
APK SHA-256: 5b0491dbc8d921ebc416e3eb6919452872c7606955e89858d5fce2c9984cc453
Size: 24929450 bytes

Changes in 0.9.2:
- CONNECT now requests USB permission automatically when needed.
- A failed first scan no longer changes a successfully opened serial port to TINYSA ERROR.
- Scan failures show a clear connected-but-scan-failed message instead.
- Error messages are shown in red for easier diagnosis.
- Fixed layout from 0.9.1 remains: no horizontal main-control swipe, wrapped RBW choices, taller input fields, and 850k RBW.

Notes:
- If the red message reports USB permission or device not found, recheck the OTG connection and USB authorization.
- Debug certificate; not suitable for Play Store publishing.
- Hardware behavior depends on TinySA firmware and OEM USB implementation.
